text:
nina (design): quick idea shrink the latency header into a single, low-profile row so the heatmap gets more vertical real estate. show 4 presets (45s / 2m / 10m / 1h), a 'more' chevron to open the full selector, a tiny density toggle (label: Density) that expands to a micro-slider, and a sticky p95 badge to the right. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-flow rick (frontend): yes to less height. implementation notes: make the density expand as an absolute overlay so the chart doesn't reflow. we should show a small badge (e.g., • 20%) on the control when it's not default. animate with opacity + scale. jess (eng): heads up: the density setting changes aggregation; please include density_pct in the URL so cached endpoints match and links are reproducible. we'll also recommend debouncing slider network calls (200ms). server can expose a tiny p95 endpoint to avoid full chart recompute. meera (pm): product context: quick triage is the main use case. defaults: density 25% for most orgs. we want telemetry for preset_click, density_open, and density_change so we can tune presets. keep p95 visible and tappable to open the distribution drawer. hamid (a11y): a11y nits: presets must be keyboard reachable (either role=tablist or listbox pattern) and announce selection. density toggle must expose aria-expanded and aria-controls; the micro-slider needs aria-valuetext like "Density: 25%" and updates should be announced by aria-live polite when the chart re-renders. tooltip copy should be clear: "Sampling trims data volume; short spikes may disappear." tooltip must be dismissible with Esc. also the tiny legend chips in dark theme are failing contrast at 12px; bump contrast or increase size. rick (frontend): pseudo markup idea: ```
[45s][2m][10m][1h]
p95: 120ms
``` density-panel contains `` with `aria-valuetext` and we debounce updates. show a small dot marker on the toggle when changed. jess (eng): agreed. add `?density_pct=25` to route and log `latency_density_change` + `timebar_preset_click` events. server will memoize p95 per range for 1s. keep p95 computation separate from heatmap pipeline to reduce client lag. meera (pm): copy test: short tooltip options: A) "Sampling trims data volume; short spikes may disappear." B) "Lower density saves compute but reduces detail." hamid: which is clearer for screen reader users? hamid (a11y): option A is more concrete. also suggest the live region announce exactly: "Latency chart updated to 2 minute range, density 25 percent." keep it concise. metrics-bot: telemetry note: event `timebar_preset_click` recorded by nina at 2005550123 rick (frontend): UI nit: at very low density (<=5%) the heatmap looks noisy (thin columns). propose a low-density state: overlay badge "sparse sampling expect variance" and add a subtle diagonal hatch to cells (helps colorblind users). nina (design): great. decision for v1: ship condensed row with presets + more chevron, density toggle collapsed by default (25% default), density in URL, sticky p95, low-density overlay for <=5%, telemetry hooks, and a11y checklist actions. follow-ups: hamid to write checklist, rick to prototype overlay + keyboard flows, jess to add query param + telemetry, meera to own the copy A for tooltip. hamid (a11y): i'll post the checklist with focus order, live region string examples, aria patterns for the slider, tooltip dismiss semantics, and contrast targets by tomorrow. rick (frontend): i'll prototype the density toggle + overlay by end of week, include keyboard access, aria attributes, and the small changed-dot indicator. jess (eng): i'll add `density_pct` support to the route+metrics and expose p95 endpoint. will also debounce slider telemetry. ETA: next sprint. meera (pm): thanks team bringing to UX sync next Wed. :white_check_mark:
